mentions.name: Agent Friendly Code
mentions.description: A tool that scores a codebase for different AI coding agents using their static signals, helping users find out which agent might perform better in their codebase.
mentions.audience: Developers deciding which AI coding agent to use on their codebase
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on https://agentfriendlycode.com/

The project lets you find out which agent might perform better in your codebase. It scores the codebase for different agents using their static signals and gives you a response.
